steps: From repo root: HOME=<scratch dir> tools/godot/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot --headless --path . -s res://tools/tests/run_tests.gd ; read the FAIL line.
expected: Test 'B4: warning posted in the cycle before an event' passes (it expects StoryText EVT_NEXT_DUE).
actual: FAIL. TOTAL pass=403 fail=1. main.gd forecast_text now posts EVT_NEXT_DUE_PRICE (planet and commodity named) for price events, so the assertion is stale or the forecast text regressed. Handoff r1b reported 404 pass.

steps: Read SK_B3_PLAIN in data/story_text.json. Read route_engine.gd settle(): routes pay only upkeep; credits come from Sell orders via sold_price.
expected: Plain line matches the code: Sell orders earn 8% more per unit.
actual: Plain line says 'Routes and Sell orders earn 8% more per unit'. Routes never earn credits (they only move stock), so the Routes half is false.

steps: Read SK_B4_PLAIN. Read main.gd forecast_text(): only up/down events name planet and commodity; closed events name the planet; other kinds use the generic EVT_NEXT_DUE line.
expected: Plain line says the warning names planet and commodity for every event.
actual: Only price events name both. Closed events name the planet only; debris, pirate, asteroid and shield warnings name neither.

steps: Read SK_A2_PLAIN. Read storage.gd capacity_of(): system keys (Space Storage) return space_storage_capacity before capacity_mult is applied.
expected: 'Company storage' means planet storage, or the text says so.
actual: 'Company storage holds 50% more' is ambiguous: A1 calls Space Storage 'company storage per system', and Space Storage is not multiplied by A2.

steps: Read SK_C3_PLAIN ('Needs Space Storage (A1).'). Read skill_tree.gd prereqs('C3').
actual: prereqs('C3') = C2 and A1. C2 (Survey Beacon) is omitted from the plain line.

steps: Read SK_C2_PLAIN. Read main.gd permit_points() and skill_screen.gd (Survey button).
expected: Plain line states the condition for the one-point discount.
actual: 'The permit costs 1 skill point less' is true only after the player presses the free Survey button for that system. The line omits the step.

steps: TAG=c4 STRATEGIES=decent EXTRA='--skills=C1,C2,C4 --permit=2' qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>. Default full-tree permit run: EXTRA='--permit=2'; check notes for 'permit 2 bought at cycle N'.
expected: C4 changes a permit purchase in some reachable order.
actual: C4 requires C3 (chain), so it is never learnable before the only permit: C1 plus permit 2 costs 4 points and C4 needs 7 more, while pre-permit income is 7 to 8 points. Permit 2 is bought at cycles 3-5 in every permit run, before C4. System 3 is on hold (systems.json). Measured effect: 0 cycles, 0 credits.

steps: TAG=c2 STRATEGIES=decent EXTRA='--skills=C1,C2 --permit=2' qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>; compare with C1 only.
expected: C2 has a number or a choice that moves results.
actual: C2 median 19 = C1 only 19; the bot never presses Survey. In code the discount is net zero: C2 costs 1 point and saves 1 on permit 2. Only information is gained.

steps: TAG=p_b1 STRATEGIES=decent EXTRA='--skills=B1' qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>; compare with no skills.
expected: B1 changes a decision or a number.
actual: B1 median 28 = no skills 28, 7/8 wins both. It adds a trend arrow, best partner and a below-upkeep warning (text and warning only; no number). The bot does not react to them.

steps: TAG=p_a4 vs p_a5 (EXTRA='--skills=A1,A2,A4' and 'A1,A2,A4,A5', --skills only, no permit); TAG=p_b1/p_b2 for B2.
expected: Each skill in a branch moves the win cycle by about 1 cycle or more, or the sim figure holds.
actual: A5 adds 0 cycles after A4 (20 vs 20, cash +70). B2 adds about -1.5 cycles after B1 (28 to 26.5, 6/8 wins), within noise. A2 adds about -1 cycle. Economy sim said A5 -2 and B2 ~0.

steps: TAG=nskp STRATEGIES=decent EXTRA='--skills=C1 --permit=2' qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>; also TAG=logi EXTRA='--skills=A1,A2,A4,A5'.
expected: Decent player wins between cycles 22 and 30 (balance targets: skilled 22-26).
actual: C1 + permit 2 wins 8/8 at cycles 18-19 (median 19). Logistics only wins 8/8 at median 20. Every single-branch set tested wins before 22.

steps: TAG=c3s STRATEGIES=decent EXTRA='--skills=C1,C2,A1,C3 --permit=2' qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>; compare TAG=nskp.
expected: C3 changes the win cycle by a small, intended amount, and the decent player still wins.
actual: C3 (cross-system routes) moves the win from median 19 to 30 and loses 2 of 8 seeds at the cycle-30 window. Runs end with 22 ships and cash near 0 (cash at cycle 15 = 34). Whether this is real balance or bot ship-greed is UNKNOWN.

steps: TAG=full STRATEGIES=decent SEEDS='1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8' qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out> (no EXTRA). Check skill_log and skill_points_left.
expected: Full tree is reachable in a normal game (economy sim median 23 assumes every skill owned from cycle 0).
actual: Full tree needs 20 points. Without a permit the decent bot earns 7 to 8 points and learns 6 skills (B1,B2,C1,A1,A2,C2) with 0 left. A4, A5, B3, B4, C3 and C4 are never bought. Median win 26 is for this subset, not the full tree.

steps: TAG=fullp STRATEGIES=decent EXTRA='--permit=2' qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>; read skill_points_left in results_fullp.jsonl.
expected: Skill points are a scarce, spent resource through the run.
actual: After permit 2, points pile up: 15 unspent at win with all 12 skills bought (fullp), 28 in expp, 20 in nskp. No sink exists except system 3, which is on hold.

steps: Before the fix: TAG=nosk STRATEGIES=decent EXTRA='--skills=' qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>.
expected: No skill learned (same as skill-less play).
actual: --skills= (empty) was treated as 'all'. The 'no skills' batch learned the full 6-skill set. Fixed in qa/bots/bot_run.gd (--skills= or --skills=none now means no skill). Batch rerun; old rows excluded. Not committed.

steps: STRATEGIES='decent always_expand' SEEDS='1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8' with EXTRA='--skills=' and '--skills=A1,A2,A4,A5' (and full tree).
expected: decent expands on time, keeps a cash reserve and buys permits (brief); always_expand buys whenever cash allows. The two differ.
actual: Outcomes identical on all 8 seeds in every set tested. bot_run.gd sets DECENT_FROM_CYCLE 1, DECENT_RESERVE 0, DECENT_LANES 24 (matching tools/sim.py), and decent buys no permits unless --permit. So dominance between these two cannot be judged. Producer to decide which definition to keep.
